Note 6 (ticket 1):

reason: Five of six agent notes (HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities) consistently confirm Keith Mclaughlin (E032) is a full-time Analyst. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so the Analyst does not own it and admin is not applicable. Per policy, full-time employees may have up to write access. The requested write is at or below that maximum, so grant write. One conflicting Security note claims contractor status, but the preponderance of corroborating records supports full-time; even so, granting write matches the recommendation of the five consistent notes.
